slides.headline: Specimen Sorter API
slides.lede: Sorter middleware calls one POST on lis-crs-spec-ack-svc. It sends out or registers the tube by USID, with the checks and packing Specimen Acknowledgement runs today.
slides.notes: Design closed on 10 Sep with Tony Chong as reviewer. Two changes since: no lab column on the map (14 Sep) and the sorter now comes in through HA APIM (15 Sep). The Change Request key still has to be created by hand.

slides.title: What this review covers

items.title: Background
items.note: Staff clicks today, sorter calls tomorrow

items.title: Existing design

slides.notes: Most of the time should go on the outcome flow and the sorter map. Those carry the decisions.

slides.title: Staff scan and click today. The sorter will call LIS

left.label: As-is
left.title: Staff scan and press
points: Action: scan the label, then Send-out or Register

slides.notes: Middleware cannot call the staff register endpoint on its own, because the packing is built on the screen first. That is the whole reason for a new API.

slides.title: The Spec Ack screen owns validation and packing

rows.text: Soft to ALS, hard to Failure

slides.notes: The service only runs the writes. Everything in the second column is what moves behind the new API.

slides.title: One POST, the screen logic behind it, one map table

cards.title: New API
cards.body: POST /api/sorter/auto-register on lis-crs-spec-ack-svc. Staff /api/specack is unchanged.

cards.title: Move screen logic
cards.body: Retrieve, validation and packing run server-side, then the existing send-out, register, print and PHLC.

cards.title: Sorter map
cards.body: loe_specimen_sorter_map: sorter id to LIS user, hospital, server and workbench.

cards.title: Audit
cards.body: SORT_* actions plus today's REG and SEND_OUT on LOE_AUDIT_TRAIL.

slides.notes: No new service and no DDL on workbench. The staff click path stays as the fallback bin.

slides.title: Every tube ends in one of four statuses

fallthrough.label: No
fallthrough.title: FAILURE
fallthrough.body: Unknown sorter, lab, mixed, hard check, 4422

condition.label: Returned on data.status
condition.note: HTTP 200 on every decision. Soft alerts go to ALS, never the body.

slides.notes: A tube with both local and send-out tests fails rather than splitting (D3). Relabel is never reported as Failure.

slides.title: Middleware calls through HA APIM with a gateway key

findings.title: Gateway headers
findings.body: x-gateway-apikey and x-ha-hospcode. No Hub JWT.

findings.title: Hospital is optional
findings.body: Omitted: loesort_hosp. Different from the map: Failure.

findings.title: Bin from data.status
findings.body: HTTP 200 is not Registered. 500 means retry.

slides.notes: Same hosts and headers as the GCRS-LIS API specification v1.0, but a new APIM product. Business failure codes sit on data.code, never as an HTTP 4xx from LIS.

slides.title: User and workbench come from the sorter id, not a PC

left.label: Staff today
left.title: Login decides
points: Workbench: selectWorkbench by PC name or IP

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Sorter id decides
points: Workbench: map wkbh_id plus the order's lab

slides.notes: The sorter must never use the retrieve GET, because of the hard-coded user. Audit rows carry the map user and the workbench station name.

slides.title: loe_specimen_sorter_map has no lab column

rows: Hospital when the request omits it
Workbench, loaded with the order's lab

takeaways.title: One sorter, more than one lab
takeaways.body: Lab comes from the retrieved order. Seed one workbench row per lab; a missing row is Failure (D12).

slides.notes: Rollback is DROP TABLE. Location, station name and printer stay on workbench, so they are not copied onto the map.

slides.title: Only REGISTERED prints, and only after the response

rows: All worksheets, then PHLC, after return

slides.notes: A late worksheet does not change a status already returned (D4). Print failure is an ALS warning, nothing more.

slides.title: One synchronous call per tube

stats.label: Labs on the order
stats.body: APS, BBS and MBS return Failure

slides.notes: Print sits outside the 4 second budget, which is why it runs after the response. PWH volumes are a later wave, not a v1 pass mark.

slides.title: Seed the map, open the gateway path, pilot CPS and HMS

left.title: Promotion
steps: Seed a workbench row per lab.
Insert the map row, with no lab.
Publish the APIM product and NetworkPolicy.

right.title: Fallback
steps: Stop the middleware. Staff Spec Ack is unchanged.

slides.notes: Confirm the Audit Trail filter shows SORT_* before the pilot, or staff cannot find the sorter's attempts.

slides.title: Four things to settle before SIT

asks.q: Does in-process retrieveGcrOrder need the lab before the USID lookup?
asks.why: D13. If yes, fix the retrieve, not the map.

asks.q: Is the APIM gateway key the only sorter credential for v1?
Who creates the Change Request key?
asks.why: SIT evidence has no ticket yet.

asks.q: Which 2027 promotion window do we file under?
asks.why: June and July 2027 are past the published calendar.

slides.notes: D1 to D12 are answered by the requester. D13 is the only open design point; the other three are delivery.

slides.headline: Q&A
slides.notes: Likely questions: why not let middleware call the staff register; why hospital can be omitted; why mixed tubes fail.

slides.headline: Target completion
slides.note: Development runs to 31 Dec 2026. Integration test starts January 2027.
